description: S002, S003, and S006 establish a Tuzi gathering and road block but state no numerical attendance or clear minimum of 50. Publicity/support metrics, police presence, and crowd-related phrasing cannot supply the missing turnout.
required_followup: Look for a contemporaneous numerical crowd estimate or a clearly bounded qualitative statement, then keep the candidate pending if it remains absent.

description: The RFE/RL report records a meeting with the deputy prime minister and health minister but no disclosed outcome. Three arrests concerned hospitality operators, and criminal complaints concerned the mayor and two officials; neither establishes arrest of demonstrators. Antena M gives no violence or injury information; beatings, forced dispersal, injury, protester violence, shootings, and killings remain unknown.
required_followup: Find event-specific reporting or official records that clarify the meeting result and whether coercive action or harm was directed at assembled residents.

description: S002 (RFE/RL), S003 (Antena M), and S006 (Anadolu Agency) are three outlet accounts, but their reporting independence has not been established. S006 exposes only a public excerpt; this limits comparison of the full source texts.
required_followup: If further review is authorized, assess the reporting origin and whether the accounts are independent; do not treat outlet count as independent confirmation by itself.

description: KAP pensioners’ February 2, 5, 12, 19, and 26 entries are reported as notices in search-result excerpts; no February occurrence or turnout is confirmed, and the table text around a possible number is corrupted/ambiguous.
required_followup: Consult a legible underlying notice/report and contemporary coverage to verify which gatherings occurred, their attendance, and the episode boundary.

description: The Vektra Boka Feb 11 and Bauxite Mine Feb 25 items concern proposed gatherings, with report excerpts indicating postponement/non-permission; no actual event is verified. Planned headcounts or applications are not attendance.
required_followup: Search for contemporaneous follow-up confirming whether either group later assembled, where, with what demand, and how many attended.

description: Searches included English, Montenegrin/Serbian Latin and Cyrillic, weekly periods, multiple localities, and labour leads, but open-web indexing is uneven and not equivalent to LexisNexis or a full local archive. Most non-Tuzi notices remain search-only; no absence conclusion follows.
required_followup: Use available local newspaper and union archives or the official notice register if later authorized and accessible; preserve language and archive coverage limits.

description: Official Mass Mobilization baseline version, universe, inclusion manual, source-use conditions, and mapping remain pending coordinator verification; this dossier is a local research candidate set only.
required_followup: Coordinator verifies the authorized baseline and original coding procedure before any integration or official eligibility judgment.
